channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2018-20753 — Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Kaseya VSA RMM allows unprivileged remote attackers to execute PowerShell payloads on all managed devices.

item.title: CVE-2015-0311 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Unspecified vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2017-11317 — Telerik User Interface (UI) for ASP.NET AJAX
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Telerik.Web.UI in Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX allows remote attackers to perform arbitrary file uploads or execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2015-2502 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2020-2509 — QNAP QNAP Network-Attached Storage (NAS)
item.description: Threat Signal 67. QNAP NAS devices contain a command injection vulnerability which could allow attackers to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-21551 — Dell dbutil Driver
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Dell dbutil driver contains an insufficient access control vulnerability which may lead to escalation of privileges, denial-of-service (DoS), or information disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2007-3010 — Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise
item.description: Threat Signal 79. masterCGI in the Unified Maintenance Tool in Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise Communication Server allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2015-5122 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Use-after-free vulnerability in the DisplayObject class in the ActionScript 3 (AS3) implementation in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2015-0313 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2018-10561 — Dasan Gigabit Passive Optical Network (GPON) Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Dasan GPON Routers contain an authentication bypass vulnerability. When combined with CVE-2018-10562, exploitation can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-27852 — Checkbox Checkbox Survey
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in CheckboxWeb.dll of Checkbox Survey allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2021-38646 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Office Access Connectivity Engine contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-24521 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2022-26871 — Trend Micro Apex Central
item.description: Threat Signal 64. An arbitrary file upload vulnerability in Trend Micro Apex Central could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2015-5123 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Use-after-free vulnerability in the BitmapData class in the ActionScript 3 (AS3) implementation in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2015-3113 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2021-31166 — Microsoft HTTP Protocol Stack
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Microsoft HTTP Protocol Stack contains a vulnerability in http.sys that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-22965 — VMware Spring Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux application running on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to remote code execution (RCE) via data binding.

item.title: CVE-2021-45382 — D-Link Multiple Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 80. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in all series H/W revisions routers via the DDNS function in ncc2 binary file.

item.title: CVE-2022-1040 — Sophos Firewall
item.description: Threat Signal 80. An authentication bypass vulnerability in User Portal and Webadmin of Sophos Firewall allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-0543 — Redis Debian-specific Redis Servers
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Redis is prone to a (Debian-specific) Lua sandbox escape, which could result in remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-1096 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2022-23176 — WatchGuard Firebox and XTM
item.description: Threat Signal 61. WatchGuard Firebox and XTM appliances allow a remote attacker with unprivileged credentials to access the system with a privileged management session via exposed management access.

item.title: CVE-2021-28799 — QNAP Network Attached Storage (NAS)
item.description: Threat Signal 86. QNAP NAS running HBS 3 contains an improper authorization vulnerability which can allow remote attackers to log in to a device.

item.title: CVE-2021-3156 — Sudo Sudo
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Sudo contains an off-by-one error that can result in a heap-based buffer overflow, which allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2021-34484 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Windows User Profile Service contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2014-9163 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Stack-based buffer overflow in Adobe Flash Player allows attackers to execute code remotely.

item.title: CVE-2021-42287 — Microsoft Active Directory
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2021-42278 — Microsoft Active Directory
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-20316 — Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC)
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) formerly known as Firepower Management Center contains a use of hard-coded password vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to log in to an affected device using a low-privileged account to access sensitive data within the impacted systems.

item.title: CVE-2018-10562 — Dasan Gigabit Passive Optical Network (GPON) Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Dasan GPON Routers contain an authentication bypass vulnerability. When combined with CVE-2018-10561, exploitation can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-22954 — VMware Workspace ONE Access and Identity Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 90. VMware Workspace ONE Access and Identity Manager allow for remote code execution due to server-side template injection.

item.title: CVE-2018-7602 — Drupal Core
item.description: Threat Signal 90. A remote code execution vulnerability exists within multiple subsystems of Drupal that can allow attackers to exploit multiple attack vectors on a Drupal site.

item.title: CVE-2022-22675 — Apple macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 58. macOS Monterey contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow an application to execute arbitrary code with kernel privileges.

item.title: CVE-2021-34486 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Microsoft Windows Event Tracing contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2017-0148 — Microsoft SMBv1 server
item.description: Threat Signal 86. The SMBv1 server in Microsoft allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.

item.title: CVE-2021-39793 — Google Pixel
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Google Pixel contains a possible out-of-bounds write due to a logic error in the code that could lead to local escalation of privilege.

item.title: CVE-2021-22600 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 55. Linux Kernel contains a flaw in the packet socket (AF_PACKET) implementation which could lead to incorrectly freeing memory. A local user could exploit this for denial-of-service (DoS) or possibly for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2022-22674 — Apple macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 51. macOS Monterey contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could allow an application to read kernel memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-85046 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2026-66384 — JFrog Artifactory
item.description: Threat Signal 58. JFrog Artifactory contains an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory vulnerability. This can allow an authenticated user to write data outside the intended Docker cache path under specific remote-repository conditions.

item.title: CVE-2025-55182 — Meta React Server Components
item.description: Threat Signal 92. Meta React Server Components contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution by exploiting a flaw in how React decodes payloads sent to React Server Function endpoints. Please note CVE-2025-66478 has been rejected, but it is associated with CVE-2025- 55182.

item.title: CVE-2025-61882 — Oracle E-Business Suite
item.description: Threat Signal 92. Oracle E-Business Suite contains an unspecified vulnerability in the BI Publisher Integration component. The vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Concurrent Processing. Successful attacks can result in takeover of Oracle Concurrent Processing.

item.title: CVE-2025-10035 — Fortra GoAnywhere MFT
item.description: Threat Signal 92. Fortra GoAnywhere MFT contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability allows an actor with a validly forged license response signature to deserialize an arbitrary actor-controlled object, possibly leading to command injection.

item.title: CVE-2026-15409 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 91. SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to potentially cause the appliance to make requests to unintended location.
